name: Western Dental & Orthodontics
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public pages only: the westerndental.com 'Pay bill' link goes to the PersonaPay (RevSpring) page personapay.com/western-dental/login (no lookup submitted), and the Insurance & financing page. Bill pay access uses the full account number from the last statement without the dash (if it is shorter than 9 digits, zeros go after the office number and before the chart number, e.g. 123-012345), plus ZIP code and date of birth; modelled as sign-in by account number and, for paying without an account, a lookup with exactly account number, ZIP and date of birth. Support specialists: (866) 620-8390 and (866) 624-7215 on the bill-pay page; catalog line (800) 579-3783 not shown there (not used). Western Dental does not offer its own payment plans; financing through CareCredit and Sunbit; accepts many insurance plans, Medi-Cal and Medicaid. No AutoPay, paperless, fees or phone/mail payment options are published; those keep family defaults. Reviewer: the real 'Pay bill' link opens one page, 'Access your account securely', that asks for account number, ZIP and date of birth with no password; it is modelled as the pay-without-signing-in page (nav 'Pay bill' -> guest, label guestPay), and the password sign-in ('Sign in') is a synthetic account area kept for the family's signed-in flows.

help.title: Pay your Western Dental bill
paragraphs: To reach your account, enter the full account number from your last statement without the dash, plus your ZIP code and date of birth.
If your account number is shorter than 9 digits, add zeros after the office number and before the chart number. For example, 123-012345 is entered as 123012345.
Then review your account, choose a payment option and pay. For help finding your account number, call a support specialist at (866) 624-7215 or (866) 620-8390.
steps: Enter your 9-digit account number, ZIP code and date of birth.
Choose a payment option and pay.

help.title: Insurance and financing
paragraphs: Western Dental accepts many major insurance plans as well as Medi-Cal and Medicaid. It does not offer payment plans itself, but CareCredit and Sunbit financing can help spread out the cost whether or not you have insurance.
New patients may qualify for a free checkup and X-rays; see your office for details.
